scenario: In + summer + it is + hot
grammar: Yazın hava sıcak (In summer it is hot)
en: In summer, it is hot and sunny.
ipa: /ɪn ˈsʌmər ɪt ɪz hɑt ænd ˈsʌni/
trPron: İn samır it iz hot end sani
collocations: in summer it, it is hot
commonMistake: On summer, it is hot. ❌
aiExplain: Mevsimler "in" ile kullanılır. Yazın hava sıcak.

scenario: In + winter + it is + cold
grammar: Kışın hava soğuk (In winter it is cold)
en: In winter, it is cold and snowy.
ipa: /ɪn ˈwɪntər ɪt ɪz koʊld ænd ˈsnoʊi/
trPron: İn vintır it iz kold end snoi
collocations: in winter it, it is cold
commonMistake: At winter, it is cold. ❌

scenario: In + spring + it is + warm
grammar: İlkbaharda hava ılık (In spring it is warm)
en: In spring, it is warm and flowers bloom.
tr: İlkbaharda hava ılıktır ve çiçekler açar.
ipa: /ɪn sprɪŋ ɪt ɪz wɔrm ænd ˈflaʊərz blum/
trPron: İn spring it iz vorm end flauırz blum
collocations: in spring it, it is warm
commonMistake: On spring, it is warm. ❌

scenario: In + autumn + it is + cool
grammar: Sonbaharda hava serin (In autumn it is cool)
en: In autumn, it is cool and the leaves change color.
tr: Sonbaharda hava serindir ve yapraklar renk değiştirir.
ipa: /ɪn ˈɔtəm ɪt ɪz kul ænd ðə livz tʃeɪnʤ ˈkʌlər/
trPron: İn otım it iz kul end dı livz çeync kalır
collocations: in autumn it, it is cool
commonMistake: In fall, it is cool and the leaves change color. ✔️

scenario: It is + hotter + in + place A + than + place B
en: It is hotter in Antalya than in Istanbul.
ipa: /ɪt ɪz ˈhɑtər ɪn ˈɑntɑljə ðæn ɪn ɪstænˈbʊl/
trPron: İt iz hatır in Antalya den in İstanbul
collocations: it is hotter, hotter in than
commonMistake: It is more hot in Antalya than in Istanbul. ❌

scenario: It is + colder + in + place A + than + place B
en: It is colder in Erzurum than in Izmir.
ipa: /ɪt ɪz ˈkoʊldər ɪn ˌɛrzəˈrum ðæn ɪn ˈɪzmɪr/
trPron: İt iz koldır in Erzurum den in İzmir
collocations: it is colder, colder in than
commonMistake: It is more cold in Erzurum than in Izmir. ❌

scenario: It is + too + hot + to + verb
en: It is too hot to go outside.
ipa: /ɪt ɪz tu hɑt tu goʊ ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
trPron: İt iz tu hot tu go autsayd
collocations: it is too, too hot to
commonMistake: It is very hot outside. ✔️
aiExplain: Too hot (çok sıcak) yapılamayacak bir aktiviteyi belirtir.
imgQuery: person staying inside looking at sun

scenario: It is + too + cold + to + verb
en: It is too cold to go swimming.
ipa: /ɪt ɪz tu koʊld tu goʊ ˈswɪmɪŋ/
trPron: İt iz tu kold tu go swimİng
collocations: it is too, too cold to
commonMistake: It is very cold outside. ✔️
aiExplain: Too cold (çok soğuk) yapılamayacak bir aktiviteyi belirtir.

scenario: It is + not + sunny
grammar: Hava güneşli değil (it is not sunny)
en: It is not sunny today. It's cloudy.
ipa: /ɪt ɪz nɑt ˈsʌni təˈdeɪ ɪts ˈklaʊdi/
trPron: İt iz nat sani tudey its klaudi
collocations: it is not, not sunny
commonMistake: It isn't sunny today. It's cloudy. ✔️

scenario: It is + not + raining
en: It is not raining anymore. The rain stopped.
ipa: /ɪt ɪz nɑt ˈreɪnɪŋ ˈɛnɪmɔr ðə reɪn stɑpt/
trPron: İt iz nat reynİng enimor dı reyn stapt
collocations: it is not, not raining
commonMistake: It's not raining anymore. The rain stopped. ✔️

scenario: There is + a + heatwave (sıcak hava dalgası)
en: There is a heatwave in Europe this week.
tr: Bu hafta Avrupa'da bir sıcak hava dalgası var.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈhitweɪv ɪn ˈjʊrəp ðɪs wik/
trPron: Der iz ı hitveyv in Yurıp dis vik
collocations: there is a, is a heatwave
commonMistake: It's a heatwave in Europe this week. ✔️
aiExplain: Sıcak hava dalgası (heatwave) olağandışı sıcaklık dönemi.

scenario: There is + a + cold snap (soğuk hava dalgası)
en: There is a cold snap in the region this week.
tr: Bu hafta bölgede bir soğuk hava dalgası var.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz ə koʊld snæp ɪn ðə ˈriʤən ðɪs wik/
trPron: Der iz ı kold snap in dı ricın dis vik
collocations: there is a, is a cold snap
commonMistake: It's a cold snap in the region this week. ✔️
aiExplain: Soğuk hava dalgası (cold snap) olağandışı soğukluk dönemi.

scenario: It is + adjective + and + adjective
en: Today's weather is sunny and warm.
ipa: /təˈdeɪz ˈwɛðər ɪz ˈsʌni ænd wɔrm/
trPron: Tudeyz vedır iz sani end vorm
collocations: weather is sunny, sunny and warm
commonMistake: Today's weather is sunny, warm. ✔️
aiExplain: Hava durumu özeti iki sıfatı "and" ile birleştirir.

scenario: It is + cloudy + with + rain
en: It is cloudy with a chance of rain.
tr: Hava bulutlu ve yağmur olasılığı var.
ipa: /ɪt ɪz ˈklaʊdi wɪð ə ʧæns əv reɪn/
trPron: İt iz klaudi wit ı çans ov reyn
collocations: cloudy with, with a chance
commonMistake: It is cloudy and rainy. ✔️

scenario: The + UV + index + is + high
en: The UV index is high today. Wear sunscreen.
tr: Bugün UV indeksi yüksek. Güneş kremi sürün.
ipa: /ðə juː viː ˈɪndɛks ɪz haɪ təˈdeɪ wɛr ˈsʌnskrin/
trPron: Dı yu vi indeks iz hay tudey ver sunskrin
collocations: UV index is, index is high
commonMistake: The UV is high today. Wear sunscreen. ✔️
aiExplain: UV indeksi güneşin ciltte hasar yapma seviyesini belirtir.

scenario: The + air + quality + is + poor
en: The air quality is poor today. Stay inside.
tr: Bugün hava kalitesi kötü. İçeride kalın.
ipa: /ðə ɛr ˈkwɑləti ɪz pʊr təˈdeɪ steɪ ɪnˈsaɪd/
trPron: Dı er kvaliti iz pur tudey stey insayd
collocations: air quality is, is poor
commonMistake: The air quality is bad today. ✔️
aiExplain: Hava kalitesi (air quality) sağlık için önemlidir.

scenario: The + weather + app + says + it will rain
en: The weather app says it will rain tomorrow.
tr: Hava durumu uygulaması yarın yağmur yağacağını söylüyor.
ipa: /ðə ˈwɛðər æp sɛz ɪt wɪl reɪn təˈmɑroʊ/
trPron: Dı vedır ep sez it vil reyn tumaro
collocations: weather app says, app says it
commonMistake: According to the weather app, it will rain tomorrow. ✔️

scenario: Take + an + umbrella + because + it is raining
en: Take an umbrella because it is raining.
ipa: /teɪk æn ʌmˈbrɛlə bɪˈkɔz ɪt ɪz ˈreɪnɪŋ/
trPron: Teyk en ambrela bikoz it iz reynİng
collocations: Present Continuous
commonMistake: Take umbrella because it is raining. ❌

scenario: Wear + a + coat + because + it is cold
en: Wear a coat because it is cold outside.
ipa: /wɛr ə koʊt bɪˈkɔz ɪt ɪz koʊld ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
trPron: Ver ı kout bikoz it iz kold autsayd
collocations: Present Simple
commonMistake: Wear coat because it is cold. ❌

scenario: Wear + sunglasses + because + it is sunny
en: Wear sunglasses because it is sunny.
tr: Güneş gözlüğü tak çünkü hava güneşli.
ipa: /wɛr ˈsʌnˌglæsəz bɪˈkɔz ɪt ɪz ˈsʌni/
trPron: Ver sanglasız bikoz it iz sani
collocations: Present Simple
commonMistake: Wear sunglasses because of the sun. ✔️
aiExplain: Güneşli havada güneş gözlüğü takmayı hatırlatma.

scenario: Wear + a + hat + to + protect + from + the + sun
en: Wear a hat to protect yourself from the sun.
ipa: /wɛr ə hæt tu prəˈtɛkt jərˈsɛlf frʌm ðə sʌn/
trPron: Ver ı hat tu protekt yörself fıram dı san
collocations: Present Simple
commonMistake: Wear hat to protect yourself from the sun. ❌
aiExplain: Güneşten korunmak için şapka takmayı hatırlatma.

scenario: Wear + a + scarf + because + it is windy
en: Wear a scarf because it is windy outside.
ipa: /wɛr ə skɑrf bɪˈkɔz ɪt ɪz ˈwɪndi ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
trPron: Ver ı skarf bikoz it iz vindi autsayd
collocations: Present Simple
commonMistake: Wear scarf because it is windy. ❌

scenario: Wear + gloves + because + it is freezing
en: Wear gloves because it is freezing outside.
tr: Eldiven giy çünkü dışarısı dondurucu soğuk.
ipa: /wɛr glʌvz bɪˈkɔz ɪt ɪz ˈfrizɪŋ ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
trPron: Ver glavz bikoz it iz frizİng autsayd
collocations: Present Simple
commonMistake: Wear gloves because it's very cold. ✔️

scenario: We + cancelled + the + trip + because + of + the + storm
grammar: Hava nedeniyle plan iptal etme (because of the storm)
en: We cancelled the trip because of the storm.
ipa: /wi ˈkænsəld ðə trɪp bɪˈkɔz əv ðə stɔrm/
trPron: Vi kansıld dı trip bikoz ov dı storm
collocations: cancelled because of, because of the storm
commonMistake: We cancelled the trip due to the storm. ✔️
aiExplain: Olumsuz hava koşulları nedeniyle plan iptal etme.

scenario: We + will + reschedule + the + event + because + of + the + snow
grammar: Hava nedeniyle plan erteleme (because of the snow)
en: We will reschedule the event because of the snow.
ipa: /wi wɪl riˈskɛʤul ði ɪˈvɛnt bɪˈkɔz əv ðə snoʊ/
trPron: Vi vil riskecul di ivent bikoz ov dı sno
collocations: will reschedule, because of the snow
commonMistake: We will reschedule the event due to snow. ✔️
aiExplain: Olumsuz hava koşulları nedeniyle etkinliği erteleme.
